newsitem.title: JAPAN: TEPCO cuts output by half at 1.1 mln kw reactor.
newsitem.headline: TEPCO cuts output by half at 1.1 mln kw reactor.

text.p: Tokyo Electric Power Co Inc (TEPCO) said it had cut output by half at a 1.1 million kilowatt (kw) reactor in Niigata Prefecture on the Sea of Japan coast after it leaked coolant water on Tuesday morning.
"Following the leakage, we lowered the output at the reactor to 540,000 kilowatts as a precaution," a TEPCO spokesman said.

He said about 20 litres of radioactive water leaked from a pump which sends coolant water to the reactor pressure vessel, although the water was contained inside the facility housing the reactor and no radiation leaked into the environment.
The cause of the leak is currently under investigation.
The unit, one of seven reactors at the Kashiwazaki-Kariwa nuclear power plant, had been closed for maintenance checks since late June and resumed operations on Sunday evening.
